scope: GAP-INGEST-002 multi-line record boundaries. A wrapped account name, a field-label continuation (Opened/Closed/status/identifier) and a continued page attach to their OWNING account, never to a new or unrelated account; adjacent accounts (including repeated/similar creditor names) stay separate; conflicting readings are withheld rather than silently overwritten; source file/page/line locations stay accurate; and a completed finding traces to its source record. Implementation is closed by bc-gap-ingest-002 + ah-multifile-assessment + an-payment-history-grid; staging verification is pending.

tests.expected: a wrapped account name stays one record; a status/identifier continuation reaches its owning record without overwriting the identity; repeated and similar creditor names stay separate; continuation dates and source lines stay accurate; conflicting order-for-relief dates are withheld; a completed finding traces to its source record; the real endpoints preserve the association and refuse cross-account access
a field line continues the preceding account; two accounts stay separate; a reordered or conflicting continuation is never merged
a positioned multi-column table assembles into one account without borrowing a preceding page when no continuation marker is printed
